text:
ana: Quick note from vendor sync: cloud partners are re-evaluating rack power allocations next month. This may reduce contiguous H200/H100 blades in some zones. We need a concrete contingency for marketplace waves + SI demos.
rick: Which regions are they talking about? us-east-1 or broader?
hao: Mostly us-east-1 and parts of us-west; preliminary numbers suggest 7-12% fewer effective H200 slots in dense racks. H100 is less impacted but some tall racks show thermal throttling.
megan: For planning: do we want to delay the public marketplace announcement or publish with "provisional perf" caveat? Marketing prefers to avoid delays if we can show mitigations.
carlos_nvidia: Nvidia partner update: H200 blades in partner labs saw sustained-power derate ~10% under high PUE racks. We have a microcode candidate that recovers ~5-7% in our tests. Partner-preview image ETA: Wed EOD.
tara_amd: AMD: MI300 partner microcode will be available Mon afternoon. Early lab runs show mixed long-seq behavior; some configs improve, some unchanged. We'll supply test vectors and image.
mohendra_gaudi: Habana/Gaudi: driver 2.7 stable in our test farm; no meaningful capacity change expected. Recommend baseline validation.
nana: (typo correction) ana: Ops: can we map derate -> tokens/sec delta and estimate slot impact on our SKU allocations? Need a quick script or CSV.
hao: I have a perf mapping snippet: ```derate_to_throughput = lambda d, baseline: baseline * (1 - d)``` We'll run for d in [0.05,0.10,0.15] across SKUs and upload CSV.
megan: Legal/Comms: if we publish and later adjust perf claims by >5% we need a correction path. Legal requested a 48h buffer for any correction; Marketing asks for 72h notice to press.
carlos_nvidia: We'll ask our program team if partner-preview can be accelerated. For now, please hold public press until we validate post-image metrics.
rick: Ops fallback options: 1) Reduce advertised concurrent H200 slots by X% for impacted regions. 2) Enable routing: long-context models -> MI300 where capacity exists, else fallback to B200 with throttling. 3) Add a "provisional" badge on marketplace SKUs. Which do we prefer?
megan: Preference: keep availability but show provisional badge + tooltip that links to partner note. Only hold press if derate >10% and vendor fix ETA >72h.
hao: I'll run sweeps in staging (long-context + short) for H200/MI300/Gaudi as soon as partner images land. Deploy bot scheduling now.
ci-bot: scheduled perf-sweep jobs: #10458 (staging-us-east-1) and #10459 (staging-eu-west-1). Images: nvidia/h200:preview, amd/mi300:preview, habana/gaudi:2.7. ETA results ~6h after images present.
tara_amd: We'll upload MI300 preview image to s3://partners/mi300/preview and attach test config.
mohendra_gaudi: Gaudi driver available at s3://partners/gaudi/2.7. No special test configs beyond baseline.
rick: Product ask: add sku_flag flow: ```sku_flags = ["available","provisional_perf","pending_vendor_patch"]``` and gating CSV: region,sku,flag,expected_fix_date,notes. We'll consume that on publish.
megan: Legal approves the banner copy: "Performance profiles provisional pending vendor firmware; see partner note for measured deltas." Marketing ok with 72h press buffer if needed.
carlos_nvidia: We'll provide a partner-only note with measured deltas after validation. For public-facing notes, coordinate via partnerships + legal.
aha: (typo) ana: SI dry-run guidance: internal canaries OK; delay outward SI demos tied to H200 perf for 48-72h until we validate vendor patches. Offer SIs migration to MI300 pools where appropriate.
hao: Running the derate sweep now. ETA ~5h; will produce CSV and a short summary with recommended slot % adjustments per region.
megan: Partnerships will draft partner note template: include measured delta, test config, impacted regions, recommended mitigations (routing and temporary slot adjustment), and expected fix ETA.
ci-bot: perf sweep job #10458 completed. Results: summary CSV uploaded to /internal/hw-perf/10458_summary.csv. Quick hit: H200 long-seq throughput median -9.8% in us-east cluster; MI300 varied -2.5% to +3% depending on microcode build. Full CSV link in the doc.
rick: Thanks. Based on -9.8% H200, ops recommendation: reduce new H200 slot allocations by 10% in us-east-1 until patch validated; enable routing-policy: long-context -> MI300 when available. I'll open PR for routing-policy:v1.
carlos_nvidia: Microcode candidate validated in our lab showing +6% recovery. We'll push partner-preview image tonight; ETA for partner rollout depends on cloud partner validation.
tara_amd: MI300 preview image uploaded. We recommend running the same test vectors listed in the partner note.
mohendra_gaudi: No change on Gaudi.
megan: Okay: actions recap: (1) Partnerships draft partner note + partner-only matrix (megan). (2) Ops reduce H200 new-slot allocations by 10% in impacted regions and enable routing-policy draft (rick/hao). (3) Eng run follow-up sweeps post-vendor-preview (hao/ci-bot). (4) Product add provisional badge and link to partner note (rick). (5) Legal/Marketing finalize press buffer & correction template (megan). Vendors: upload previews and compat matrices. We'll hold public press if derate >10% and fix ETA >72h.
nana: (typo again) ana: thanks all. Will keep channel updated and ping when partner note draft is ready. :handshake:
